has been working with an investment bank to consider its options and has had preliminary discussions with DoorDash

, the ride-hailing firm recently walked away from talks, according to a  Bloomberg report on Friday, which cited a person familiar with the matter. The companies are no longer in discussions.
Instacart has a market cap of $12 billion, while DoorDash is valued at more than $80 billion, and Uber is worth $141 billion.
Shares of Uber fell 3.7%, while DoorDash dropped 3.8%. Instacart stock had risen 15% this year before today.
An Instacart spokesperson declined to comment to Seeking Alpha. DoorDash and Uber didn't immediately respond to an email request for comment.
